verdict.rationale: Airbyte documents that API access requires an access token and that Cloud/paid tiers offer RBAC and SSO, suggesting some permission control exists, but there is no documentation of issuing scoped or least-privilege credentials specifically for AI agents (e.g., per-agent API keys, granular scopes tied to MCP usage). missing for 10: explicit scoped/least-privilege token creation flow, agent-specific credential scoping, and any evidence tying RBAC/tokens to the MCP/agent use case.
